snippet.title: HOLD MY WHEEL - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
A bunch of dudes survived the apocalypse. This is what co-op chaos looks like.
Wishlist on Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4410360/HOLD_MY_WHEEL/
Releasing August 3, 2026

Gameplay highlights from HOLD MY WHEEL — a 5-player co-op survival game where your bus is your home. Build bridges from scrap, throw your bus around with a magnetic gun, craft weapons from junk, fight zombies with a Scrap-Cannon, and try not to get eaten by your own friends.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WHAT YOU'RE SEEING
- 5-player co-op bus management
- Magnetic gun — lift, flip, and throw your bus
- Roof-mounted Scrap-Cannon firing literal junk
- Physics-based bridge-building across broken highways
- Grappling hooks for bus maneuvers
- Crafting weapons from scrap (blade-tipped fishing rods, iron clubs, glass-bottle ammo)
- Ghost / zombie / ragdoll states when you die
- Ice-cold Atomic Cola

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
LINKS

Website: https://tessermind.com/
